$comment: Mission 1.67 §37, §38 and §46. Individual verdicts only. §47 forbids choosing, ranking or comparing a pair even if two apparatuses qualified.

new_serious_candidates.name: Rapid7 Project Sonar
new_serious_candidates.one_line: The apparatus states its TCP studies include SSH; the only retrievable dataset covering arbitrary TCP ports carries SYN responses and no response bytes.

new_serious_candidates.name: Shodan
new_serious_candidates.one_line: The database is documented as updated in real time, the filter reference documents no time or date filter, and the only historical surface is a bounded per-address lookup — so a window cannot be chosen in the request.

blocker_distribution.$comment: §61. Recorded because the next mission's choice depends on which dimension is actually binding, and no single one dominates here.
blocker_distribution.note_on_documentation: The four documentation counts are prescreen hits that never became serious candidates. They are a fact about this mission's reach rather than a finding about those apparatuses, in the shape Mission 1.60 recorded — so they are reported apart from the two established epistemic blockers rather than added to them.

primary_outcome_reasoning.why_not_D_observation_addressability: D requires that temporal-object semantics DOMINATE the rejections. One of two serious candidates failed there.
primary_outcome_reasoning.why_not_E_protocol_native_exposure: E requires that raw protocol evidence dominate. The other one of two failed there. Neither dimension dominates, and choosing either would send the next mission hunting one blocker while the other is equally live.
primary_outcome_reasoning.why_not_J_documentation_insufficient: Four prescreen hits died on documentation retrievability, which is numerically the largest group. But J says first-party methodology is THE BINDING LIMITATION, and that would misdescribe the two candidates that documented themselves thoroughly and failed on epistemics. Mission 1.60 set the rule followed here: name the ESTABLISHED blocker rather than the merely unexplored one.
primary_outcome_reasoning.why_not_A_or_B: No new apparatus individually qualified. §58 forbids forcing them.
primary_outcome_reasoning.what_C_explicitly_does_not_mean: It does not mean no qualifying apparatus exists. It means none was found inside a fixed budget of 36 documents and 6 serious candidates, of which 24 documents and 2 candidates were used.

registry_decision.$comment: §44 and §59. The full reasoning lives in apparatus-frame-uniformity-requirement-review-v1.

mission_accounting.$comment: §53. Every counter the brief asks for, including the ones that must be zero. A budget that only counts successes is not a budget.
mission_accounting.api_execution_note: The only URLs fetched were public documentation pages. No endpoint that returns measurement was called, and no documented endpoint requiring a key was called at all.

parallel_state_untouched.a_sent_question_is_not_an_answer: The fact that ONYPHE was contacted improves no gate. It does not move B2, configuration, retention or reliability.

canonical_mutation_boundary.$comment: §50. Nothing in this mission writes to the research corpus.

recommended_next_mission.$comment: §61, the NO_NEW_QUALIFYING branch. Do NOT rerun the identical search.
the_choice_this_mission_does_not_make: A. broaden discovery within the same active-scanner class
B. change the protocol-native construct while preserving product relevance
C. choose another product-relevant world-state quantity independently measurable by multiple apparatuses
recommended_next_mission.what_this_mission_contributes_to_that_ch: The blocker distribution, and one structural observation: the two halves of the requirement have now been seen separately and never together. Apparatuses with raw protocol capture publish a maintained current state; the apparatus with immutable dated snapshots publishes no raw capture for this protocol. That pattern is what option B would attack, by asking whether a product-relevant predicate exists that a SYN-level or HTTP-level retrievable surface can decide.
